objective: BUKLOD Soft Modern auditory feedback, reliable caller ringback and custom native incoming ringtone
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: GitHub main 47fd152fc586fe2cb782d84cf08287e6a6f4a17f inspected on 2026-10-27 as the DEV baseline; production OTA source and installed binary compatibility remain unverified. Native ringtone assets require an EAS native build and are not OTA-only.
acceptanceChecks: Original WAV cues parse and stay under 30 seconds with bounded output gain
Messages play only on confirmed send, failures never falsely play success

Foreground push tones are deduplicated and active message threads are muted
Outgoing ringback occurs only in Stream RINGING state and stops on accept, reject or exit
Incoming native Android and iOS ringtone is configured without double JS playback
Preferences persist locally and respect quiet hours, active calls and OS controls
Run TypeScript, focused tests, native build checks, two-device call validation, RC and production gates before release
